description: Common issues and solutions for Mindcraft AI agents in Minecraft

patterns.issue: Agent gets stuck in water and cannot escape
patterns.context: When agents navigate near water blocks, they often fall in and cannot find a path out, leading to drowning or permanent stuck state
patterns.solution: NEVER send agents near water. Always check for water blocks within 5 block radius before any movement command. Use water_avoidance_radius: 5 in all pathfinding. If agent is stuck in water, use !stop then manually guide to shore.
patterns.prevention: Before any !goToPosition command, query !nearbyBlocks and verify no water within path. Avoid all ocean, river, and lake biomes.

patterns.issue: Agent dies at night without shelter
patterns.context: Agents continuing to work at night get attacked by hostile mobs and die
patterns.solution: Track Minecraft day/night cycle. Before nightfall (around tick 12000), send agent to shelter or safe lit area. Resume work at dawn.
patterns.prevention: Monitor game time. At tick 11000, start returning to base. Build or find shelter before nightfall.

patterns.issue: Agent ignores human players who join the server
patterns.context: When human players join, the agent should prioritize helping them but continues with autonomous tasks
patterns.solution: Monitor chat for 'joined the game' messages. When human joins, pause current goal and send greeting. Ask how agent can help. Prioritize human requests over autonomous goals.
patterns.prevention: Always listen for player join events. Have a greeting message ready. Switch to 'assist human' mode when players are online.

categories.safety: Patterns related to agent survival and avoiding dangerous situations
categories.helpfulness: Patterns related to assisting human players
categories.building: Patterns related to construction and structure creation
categories.navigation: Patterns related to movement and pathfinding
